# @rxova/react-phone-input

> A headless, accessible international phone input for React with no metadata
> blob: country names come from `Intl.DisplayNames`, flags from Unicode, and the
> dial-code table is about 4 kB. E.164 in, E.164 out — the value is never the
> formatted display text. Zero runtime dependencies. No stylesheet to import.

## Install

    npm install @rxova/react-phone-input

`react >= 18` is the only peer dependency.

## Minimal working example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { PhoneInput } from '@rxova/react-phone-input'

export function Signup() {
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState('')

  return <PhoneInput label="Phone number" value={phone} onChange={setPhone} defaultCountry="GB" />
}
```

`onChange` receives the E.164 string plus a `PhoneDetails` second argument:

```tsx
import { PhoneInput } from '@rxova/react-phone-input'

export function Field() {
  return (
    <PhoneInput
      label="Phone"
      onChange={(value, details) => {
        // value    '+442071234567'
        // details  { e164, country: 'GB', national: '2071234567', possible: true }
        console.log(value, details.country, details.possible)
      }}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

`<PhoneInput>` — the full surface is `PhoneInputProps` in the published types.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | — | Controlled E.164 (`'+14155552671'`) or `''`. Never the formatted text. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | — | Uncontrolled initial E.164 value. Ignored when `value` is set. |
| `onChange` | `(value: string, details: PhoneDetails) => void` | — | E.164 string plus `{ e164, country, national, possible }`. |
| `country` | `string` | — | Controlled country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. |
| `defaultCountry` | `string` | `'US'` | Initial country when uncontrolled. |
| `onCountryChange` | `(iso2: string) => void` | — | |
| `countries` | `string[]` | every country | Restricts the list, in the order given. An empty array is ignored. |
| `hideCountrySelect` | `boolean` | `false` | Drops the picker; numbers must be typed in `+…` form. |
| `countryLabel` | `string` | `'Country'` | Accessible name for the country select. |
| `renderCountry` | `(state: PhoneCountryState) => ReactNode` | flag, name and calling code | Custom option contents. |
| `locale` | `string` | the runtime's locale | BCP 47 tag for country names. |
| `maxLength` | `number` | `32` | Native `maxlength`, and enforced by the hook as well. Always applied; the prop only moves the cap. E.164 caps a number at 15 digits, so the longest text the field can format is 21 characters — `32` leaves room for pasted brackets and dashes without truncating a real number. A value below `21` or non-finite falls back to the default. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Accessible name for the number field. **Not rendered** — supply your own `<label htmlFor={`${id}-input`}>` for a visible one. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | |
| `className` | `string` | — | |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | — | |
| `name` | `string` | — | Emits a hidden input carrying the E.164 value, readable by a native `<form>`. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `showValidity` | `boolean` | `false` | After blur, reports whether the digits are a length this country uses. |
| `validityLabel` | `(state: { possible: boolean; country: Country \| undefined; details: PhoneDetails }) => ReactNode` | a stock sentence | Return `''` to say nothing. |
| `dir` | `'ltr' \| 'rtl'` | inherited | Lays the field out; segment order still comes from the locale. |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | `false` | Focuses the number field on mount. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Accessible name when there is no `label`. Wins over `label`. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`. |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | — | ids of external error/help text. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Base id; input, select and hidden field derive theirs from it. |
| `onBlur` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | — | Fires when focus leaves the whole field, never between its parts. |
| `onFocus` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | — | |
| `onWarn` | `(warning: PhoneWarning) => void` | `console.warn` | Development-only notice that a prop was coerced. Stripped from production builds. |

Also exported: the `usePhoneInput` hook (its result carries `clear()`, which
empties the number and keeps the selected country), the country helpers `COUNTRIES`,
`countryByISO2`, `countryForDial`, `countryName`, `flagEmoji`, and the pure
functions `parsePhone`, `formatPhone`, `formatNational`, `isPossible`,
`lengthsFor`, `digitsOnly`.

## Styling

There is no stylesheet. Set CSS custom properties on any ancestor:
`--rx-phone-gap`, `--rx-phone-select-width`.

Or target the `data-*` attributes, which are public API covered by semver:
`data-rx-phone-root`, `data-rx-phone-country`, `data-rx-phone-input`, `data-rx-phone-value`,
`data-rx-phone-validity`, plus the state hooks `data-country`, `data-possible`,
`data-disabled`, `data-invalid`.

## Four mistakes to avoid

1. **Reading `possible` as "valid".** It means the national part is a length this
   country actually uses. No client-side check can tell you a number is assigned
   or reachable — that needs a carrier lookup, so treat `possible` as a typo
   catcher and verify by sending a code.
2. **Storing the formatted text.** The value in and out is E.164. The pretty
   grouping changes with the country and the digit count; persisting it makes the
   stored number a presentation detail.
3. **Assuming the field is unbounded.** It accepts at most 32 characters and the
   cap cannot be removed, only moved with `maxLength` — an unbounded field is a
   denial-of-service surface, since every keystroke re-parses the whole
   contents. A `maxLength` under `21` is refused, because that is the longest
   text a full 15-digit E.164 number formats to.
4. **Shipping a metadata library alongside it.** The country names come from
   `Intl.DisplayNames` and the flags from regional-indicator codepoints — adding
   `libphonenumber` back for names or flags pays 300 kB for what the platform
   already has.
